Convolution with BCOO operands

Source: R/sparse_bcoo.R
experimental_sparse_bcoo_conv_general_dilated.Rd

Port of jax.experimental.sparse.bcoo_conv_general_dilated: one dimensional convolutions of operands with leading dimensions (1, 1), unit strides, dilations and group counts.

Usage

experimental_sparse_bcoo_conv_general_dilated(
  lhs,
  rhs,
  window_strides,
  padding,
  lhs_dilation = NULL,
  rhs_dilation = NULL,
  dimension_numbers = NULL,
  feature_group_count = 1L,
  batch_group_count = 1L,
  precision = NULL,
  preferred_element_type = NULL
)

Arguments

lhs, rhs

BCOO or dense arrays.

window_strides, padding, lhs_dilation, rhs_dilation, dimension_numbers, feature_group_count, batch_group_count, precision, preferred_element_type

As for lax_conv_general_dilated().

Value

A BCOO array.
